response.description:
Announcing the public preview of 'service tags as
inbound rules' support for third-party customers in network security perimeter. This new capability simplifies how customers manage
access to in network security
perimeter-protected resources by allowing them to use service tags
as part of network security
perimeter access rules when connecting to supported third-party
services. Learn
more.
response.title: Public Preview: Service tags for inbound rules in network security perimeter
